svg.title: RMR control panel wiring schematic
svg.text: The layered E-stop panel as designed in the 2026-10-06 panel reference. Planned wiring, not the machine as it is wired today.
+24 V always on (while K1 is in), 12 AWG to FB1
Star S at PSU V-: every 0 V return lands here on its own wire
H1 knob lamp, lit while K1 is in
B 24 V: motor contactor K2, E-stop latch
Reset pulls K2 in; 5-6 holds it;
S1-S3 sit on the door plate.
FB2 12-way +24 V cut by the E-stop (K2)
Arduino Mega 2560 on a screw-terminal breakout | Marlin, BOARD_RAMPS_14_RMR (1025) | pins by board label
0V-S (same bus as above, joined at the left)
0 V power, returns to star S
Net tag: same name = same wire
Dot = joined; crossing without a dot = not joined
Source: control panel wiring reference of 2026-10-06 (stages 0 to 9). Mega pins
checked against pins_RAMPS_14_RMR.h and Configuration_adv.h on main ad6c755
E-stop: NC1 drops K2, so FB2 loses every actuator (drivers, ODrive, servos,
UV, valve). FB1 keeps Mega, Pi, screen and tower alive to report it.
Read off the parts before wiring: tower common polarity, lid feed voltage,
valve coil, servo 6 V rating, and which side powers ODrive J11 logic.
Mega buck: the Mega datasheet (A000067, 2.1) rates VIN at 7 to 12 V and gives no
rating for feeding the 5 V pin. Pick the input, then set the buck output to suit.
Firmware gap (stage 0): kill() and motor-power loss leave pins 4 and 42 as they
were. With the UV behind K2, Reset relights the lamp until that is fixed.
Every driver: PUL-, DIR- and ENA- jumpered at the driver (COM);
one COM wire per driver to 0V-S. Driver top: +V, 0V, A+, A-, B+, B-.
F2-1 to F2-7: 5 A on 18 AWG. Motor shields to PE at the driver end only.
Mega pins are board labels (A0 = D54, A2 = D56, A8 = D62, A9 = D63).
1 k pull-ups on pin 43 and GPIO 20: they read power contacts.
Servo, lid and UV wires cross the hinge: stranded, service loop,
Sheet 1 of 2. Legal 14 x 8.5 in, landscape. Print at 100 %.
Status: design, not yet wired or tested on the machine.
Sheet 2 shows the same circuits on DIN rails.
